h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Muzaffarpur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Muzaffarpur

items.pText: Muzaffarpur is litchi country, and many school compounds, colony gardens and private grounds in and around the city already have mature trees on them. Those trees give welcome shade in the humid north Bihar summer, but they also drop leaves, fruit and twigs, and their roots lift the soil. Where you put playground equipment on a tree-lined plot matters as much as what you buy.

FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,480 km from Muzaffarpur, and sends it to Bihar by road. Our installation team or a dealer in the region installs it on your ground. Send us a photo of the site that shows the trees, its rough length and width, and the age group of the children. We will return a layout drawing with the safe play area marked around each piece.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Placing equipment under and around trees

c: Keep the outer edge of each safe play area clear of trunks and low branches. A child coming off a swing or a slide should never meet a tree. We also avoid grouting right next to a big trunk, because cutting through large roots weakens the tree and the roots can crack the base later.
Light shade from the side suits
and see-saws, which younger children use for long spells. Taller pieces such as a
are better in the open part of the plot, away from overhanging branches. In litchi season, sweep fallen fruit off decks and steps every morning, as it makes them slippery.

facts.value: About 1,480 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can playground equipment go under the trees on our Muzaffarpur school ground?
items.a: Yes, as long as the safe play area stays clear of trunks and low branches. We mark this on the layout drawing so you can see the gap before anything is made.

items.q: Do you install equipment in Muzaffarpur and nearby towns?
items.a: Yes. The equipment is made in Vasai, sent by road and installed by our own team or a dealer who works in Bihar. Towns such as Hajipur and Darbhanga are covered the same way.

items.q: Will leaves and fallen fruit damage the equipment?
items.a: Not if they are swept off regularly. Roto-moulded plastic and galvanised steel do not stain or rot, but wet leaves left on decks make them slippery and hold moisture against the fixings.
